title: Caveman route ask v1
description: The body a signed-in local runtime posts to Cloud's POST /v1/route, at most 256 KiB: the caller's models, counts computed on the machine, and the ask Cloud picks the model from (the latest human turn, the one before it and the end of the agent's last reply). Those turns go raw, with any context the agent put into them; tool calls, tool results, the system prompt and headers are not sent. The tenant comes from the bearer token, never from the body. Cloud answers with one of the models, or the runtime keeps the asked one.

models.description: The model the agent asked for first, then the other models of the same provider it may move to.

agent.description: The wrapped agent: claude, codex, …; unlabeled-agent when unknown.

tool_errors.description: Tool results in the request marked as errors.

ask.description: The conversation, raw as the agent sent it. A human turn is a user message (Anthropic Messages, OpenAI chat) or user input item (OpenAI Responses) with at least one non-blank text block, in an input group (the items between two model outputs) that carries no tool result: no Anthropic tool_result block, OpenAI chat tool message or Responses *_call_output item. Text riding along with tool results belongs to the tool loop, not to a new turn. A turn's text blocks are joined with "\n". Byte bounds are UTF-8 and every cut lands on a rune boundary. Optional fields are left out when empty. Sent together with signals.

text.description: The latest human turn. At most 131072 bytes, keeping the head.

prev_text.description: The human turn before the latest one. At most 16384 bytes, keeping the head.

reply_tail.description: The newest assistant text (not tool calls) before the latest human turn. At most 16384 bytes, keeping the end.

turn.description: Human turns before the latest one.
